All components of the claim are present in the evidence.

Canonical Face Space Transformation normalizes world coordinates to a canonical face space using a rigid transform to address face shape variations between training data and real-world inputs, making the NeRF robust to geometry and pose variations [S1, unofficial].

The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states that the method normalizes world coordinates to a canonical face space using a rigid transform to address face shape variations between training data and real-world inputs. It further confirms that this approach makes the method robust to variations in face geometry and poses, as demonstrated in ablation studies (Table 3 and Figure 10).
